== Source-supported English text states ==
The comparison records the original English face, the complete Decipher replacement wording, and the later PC Appendix A wording. Revised and Virtual editions remain in Versions. The Decipher Supplement literally prints “you” and lower-case “force” and adds “of any kind”; the PC wording uses “your” and adds the immunity exception. Shared punctuation and capitalization-only differences are preserved without extra highlights.

Primary wording: [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]], PDF page 4; [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 114. Edition dates identify the cited documents.
